For the Petitioner : Mr. Avilash Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Suraj Deo Munda, A.P.P.
-----
Order No.07 Date: 12.11.2024
4.

The petitioner has filed the present anticipatory bail application apprehending his arrest in
connection with Markacho P.S. Case No.40 of 2024 registered under Sections
341/323/379/354B/509/498A/504/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
5.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that during pendency of the instant anticipatory bail application, the petitioner has already been arrested by the police in connection with the present case and hence, the anticipatory bail application has become infructuous.
6. Considering the said submission, the present anticipatory bail application is dismissed as infructuous.

(Rajesh Shankar, J.) Vikas/
